description_en: Queries a pipeline node by pipeline node ID
description_zh: 根据管道任务id查询管道任务
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public get-pipeline-by-id --op-tenant-id 30001011 --context ProjectId=123 Env=DEV --query-id NodeId=n_123 PipelineId=123 FileId=123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetPipelineById

fields.help_en: The project ID to which the integration pipeline node belongs
fields.help_zh: 集成管道任务所属项目ID
fields.name: project_id

fields.help_en:
The current operating environment. Valid values:
DEV: the development environment.
PROD: the production environment
fields.help_zh: 当前操作环境env：DEV-表示操作开发环境，PROD-表示操作生产环境
fields.name: env

fields.help_en: The scheduling node ID of the integration node. You can use this parameter to query the pipeline node
fields.help_zh: 支持使用集成任务调度节点nodeId查询
fields.name: node_id

fields.help_en: The primary key ID of the integration pipeline. You can use this parameter to query the pipeline node
fields.help_zh: 支持使用集成管道主键pipelineId查询
fields.name: pipeline_id

fields.help_en: The file ID of the integration node. You can use this parameter to query the pipeline node
fields.help_zh: 支持使用集成任务文件fileId查询
fields.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The query ID used to query the pipeline node
parameters.name: query_id
